description: Repairing buggy Python functions to an exact written specification: identify the seeded defect in a short function and return a corrected implementation. Judged exclusively by the host function oracle (exact function_io on untouched checks) inside the Linux code sandbox. The teacher is pinned to the exact Ollama cloud tag digest; the evidence class is behavioural_remote (prompt/response only, no internal router or expert claims).

evaluation.training: Authored repair cases whose judged teacher traces may become KD teaching pairs (never any other split)
evaluation.development: Authored repair cases for iterated observation; never teaching material
evaluation.heldout: Authored repair cases untouched by any teaching decision; the honest transfer measurement
evaluation.final: Authored repair cases frozen at dataset build; NEVER opened in this pilot (final_opened stays false)
